fusion: fusion.json (2026-10-03): the morph container's gaussianRadius (lens_gauss in the f rows) per change for two opens and two closes of the bottom10 scene, and five filmed close frames of the same scene with the silhouette width per row and the logged element geometry at that moment. The container is an SDF layer with smoothness 0 whose field is blurred by gaussianRadius as a standard deviation (fit 0.9 - 1.2).
device: iPhone 16 Pro (iPhone17,1) real device, iOS 27.0.1, 402x874 pt @3x, ProMotion; display link 120 Hz (CADisableMinimumFrameDurationOnPhone, preferredFrameRateRange 80..120 pref 120)
format: jsonl, one row per line. k=start {t, scene, rec, scale, maxfps, w, h}; k=touch {t, phase 0 began / 1 moved / 3 ended, x, y} (window points, UITouch.timestamp = CACurrentMediaTime clock); k=dl one row per CADisplayLink tick {t = link.timestamp, d = duration when not 1/120} - dl rows are kept only around gestures (0.15 s before touch-down .. 1.1 s after touch-up). Rows other than dl are logged only when a value changed, so a tick with a dl row and no other row means "nothing changed this tick". k=action {t, title}; k=f per display frame while a morph exists, derived exactly like the simulator fixtures (/tmp/probe-menu/extract.py table): G_* menu blob, S_* button blob (px,py layer position; kx,ky KickView translation; s scale; bw,bh local bounds; r, clipr radii; *_list_a/_blur menu content alpha/blur, *_btn_a/_blur button glass, *_pivot_*), lens_blur, lens_gauss, btn_w/btn_h pressed glass, bar nav button, menu [cx,cy,w,h,alpha], G_rvis visual radius of the menu SDF.
notes: Menus on this phone are 82 + 42*rows pt tall (simulator 20 + 42*rows): +62 pt fixed. center3-closemidopen: the outside tap was planned 25 ms after the release and was delivered right at it (two strokes in one synthesized record). center3-early-outside-*: a release before the opening closes 16 ms after the opening (p peaks 0.167) whatever its time; the 200 ms one is released after the opening and closes 28 ms after its release.

navbar_tap: navbar-tap.json (2026-10-05): UIBarButtonItem(menu:) WITHOUT a primary action (scene menu, the nav bar's ellipsis item) - navbar3-repeat (5 tap opens + outside dismissals), navbar3-quicktap (33 ms tap), navbar3-hold300 / navbar3-hold700 (holds released on the button), navbar3-dragselect (hold 0.7 s, slide to row 3, release) - plus navbar3-dismiss and the inline references center3-repeat / center3-hold700 / center3-dragselect, reduced to logged touches, actions and the spans of the morph container (first/last tick with a MagicMorphView / MagicMorphLayer / LensingSDFLayer row), times from the first touch. Findings: a tap opens on release (first morph frame 0.0610 - 0.0632 s after later releases vs 0.0489 - 0.0495 inline: +0.013; first release after a launch 0.094 - 0.125), a hold opens at 0.260 - 0.264 s while the finger is down (inline 0.256), a release on the button after a hold leaves the menu open (no close in 1.6 s; same inline), a slide onto a row chooses it 0.012 s after the lift.
